text: āyasmā mālukyaputto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi . atha kho āyasmā mālukyaputto eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto virahanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi . aññataro ca panāyasmā mālukyaputto arahataṃ ahosīti . dutiyaṃ . [140] parihānadhammañca vo bhikkhave desissāmi aparihānadhammañca cha
